d:
holi rangotsav ke pavan avsar par
Hansraj raghuvanshi (baba ji) ka naya bhakti git “lagi lagan shankra ki” aap sabhi ke lie prastut hai.
Yah git bhagvan shiv ke prati atut bhakti, prem aur samarpan ko darshata hai.
Aap sabhi se nivedan hai ki hamesha ki tarah is git ko apna pyar aur aashirvad den
aap sabhi ko holi ki hardik shubhkamnaen
jay shankar maharaj | har har mahadev
Credits
Song: Laagi Lagan Shankara
